note: Canonical inventory of PMOVES MCP servers. Used by pmoves/tools/mcp_config_generator.py to produce client-native config snippets for Claude, Kimi, KiloCode, Hermes, and Crush. Server entries support an optional 'disabled: true' field to mark servers that should be emitted as disabled in generated configs, and an optional 'endpoint_pinned: true' field meaning the entry's 'endpoint' is what the entry IS rather than a default the caller's --endpoint may override (used by local/fleet sibling pairs that must both be emitted).

servers._note: Registered but NOT served to any client (fail-closed; `clients: []` matches nothing in ServerSpec.applies_to()). URL updated 2026-09-02 from stale mcp.composio.dev to connect.composio.dev/mcp - the current Composio Connect endpoint used by the official plugin (submodule pmoves-composio-mcp-plugin). Auth is in-band managed OAuth: agent requests connection -> OAuth link returned -> operator authorizes -> connection reusable; NOT a static X-API-Key header. Old 2026-08-27 note (superseded but preserved): operator-approved registration; populate `clients` only after the endpoint is verified live AND COMPOSIO_API_KEY is registered in the CHIT secrets manifest (slot exists: composio_api_key, tier llm) plus client launcher allowlists. The stale `disabled: true` + X-API-Key header block was removed with this update.

servers.description: Titan Mail hosted MCP (https://api.titan.email/mcp) — search/read/send email, folders, labels, calendar, contacts. OAuth via interactive Titan sign-in (no static API key). EU-hosted reseller accounts (Blacknight, MonoVM, DomainDiscount24, Fluccs, Domain Central) use https://api-euc1.titan.email/mcp instead.
servers._note: Registered 2026-09-02, NOT served to any client (fail-closed, same rule as composio). Auth is OAuth: the client must complete an interactive Titan login + consent dance. Do NOT populate `clients` until (a) the target client's MCP stack supports browser-based OAuth for remote HTTP servers, verified live, and (b) operator confirms which mailbox(es) — powerfulmoves@pmoves.ai / pmoves@pmoves.ai / @cataclysmstudios.com — connect. Also verify whether the pmoves.ai mail is even Titan-hosted before wiring (Hostinger commonly provisions Titan); inventory via Composio → Hostinger first.
